meo/galileo-iov-sar.glb.description: The 2012 IOV pair adds the search-and-rescue antenna beside the round-element navigation array.
meo/galileo-iov-sar.glb.shape: Equipment bus with two solar wings

meta.manufacturer: EADS Astrium (prime), with Thales Alenia Space
meta.dimension_note: GSC gives the bare bus dimensions, a 14.5 m deployed span and two 5.000 × 1.082 m wings. The Earth deck uses the published navigation-to-laser reference offsets.
